title: Rationalising the onset and extent of β-PdZn formation as a function of Pd:Zn ratio and its effect on methanol yield for CO2 hydrogenation studied under in situ and operando conditions
extraction_notes: No experimental CO2-hydrogenation catalyst-performance entries (conversion, selectivity, methanol yield/STY/rate, etc.) are reported in the supplied Supporting Information. The SI contains catalyst composition (SI Table S1) and characterization/in situ or operando XAS/XRD data, including XRD collected under reaction conditions in SI Figure S15, but these are out of scope because they do not report catalytic performance numbers.
